dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Cuha came into ACC as a stray; because of this we do not know how he would be in a home environment. During his time in the care center, Cuha has been noted to have a low threshold for arousal, resulting in him jumping up repeatedly against his kennel door. He is noted to lunge and pull very hard towards passing kennels, and he will thrash when handlers keep him away from the kennels. He is noted to readily engage in agility training. Cuha is noted to be very aroused during his walk and never seems to settle; he repeatedly jumps, pulls significantly, and pants heavily throughout the walk. We recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based) and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
